decisions.reason: As a newly launched product line close to the core formwork business and already given its own page, it is likely still above or near aspiration levels and the firm's growth and R&D slack support keeping it.

Because it builds on the firm's automation offering and fits its strategy of integrated factory systems, management would likely retain it while results are still emerging despite its lower website prominence.

This product line is close to the established offer and can complement broader system sales, so in an expanding firm and growing industry it would probably be kept unless performance clearly fell below aspiration.
Its own dedicated page and close fit with the firm's established modular formwork portfolio suggest sufficient strategic importance for management to keep it on the market.
Although only recently launched, it is closely related to the firm's existing magnetic formwork activities and dedicated web presentation indicates enough commitment to continue supporting it.

This is the most at-risk item because it is only mentioned on the website and appears narrower than the main lines, but the firm's expansion, available slack, and strong relatedness to the core business still make retention more likely than withdrawal.
